kitchenRules.rule: Buy the tuna at Stiles Market in Westport, and tell them it’s for tartare.
Make three times the pickle. The extra is the point — everyone takes more at the table.
Have the rib roast boned, then tied back onto the bones.
Make the hash the day before, without the eggs. Reheat it Christmas morning.
Pignoli cookies bake for 15 minutes on sprayed parchment. The batch makes 24.
Seal the mint jelly by turning the jars upside down — no water bath. Add mint flavouring if it needs it.
Napa salad: skip the fruit and the wonton. Chicken is a welcome addition.
